args.body: Hi Lena, I noticed an error from the 2026-10-14 price update: 22 fixed-price contract products (P-1201 through P-1222) incorrectly received the 3% price increase. Since then, 8 sales orders (SO-77310 to SO-77317) were placed at the increased prices, resulting in an overcharge of $4,128.60. I wanted to flag this immediately so we can revert the list prices and coordinate with sales/billing on customer adjustments.
